content.title: Recap: March Madness, Elite Eight, Day 1
content.text: Illinois celebrates advancing to the Final Four. What we know about Saturday’s Elite Eight games: No. 3 Illinois beat No. 9 Iowa 71-59 in the South regional final No. 1 Arizona defeated No. 2 Purdue 79-64 in the West regional final Today’s winners booked a spot in the Final Four in Indianapolis Check out our recaps of every NCAA Tournament game here. MARCH 28, 2026 / 11:28 ET The second team in the Final Four Koa Peat scored 20 points and the No. 1 seed Arizona Wildcats shrugged off a lethargic first half to beat Purdue and book a ticket in the Final Four. MARCH 28, 2026 / 11:14 ET A tip of the Cats Arizona coach Tommy Lloyd salutes the Wildcat fanbase MARCH 28, 2026 / 11:10 ET Get hyped, Tucson MARCH 28, 2026 / 11:06 ET Final force The top-seeded Arizona Wildcats are headed to the Final Four. MARCH 28, 2026 / 10:45 ET Cat scratch fever The Wildcats are beginning to assert themselves down the stretch. Peat will not be denied 😤 #MarchMadness We're heading down the stretch in a tight one: https://t.co/73IDsYprmk pic.twitter.com/UsX9ohHPBu — NCAA March Madness (@MarchMadnessMBB) March 29, 2026 MARCH 28, 2026 / 10:33 ET Raising Arizona Anthony Dell’Orso nailed a huge 3 and the Wildcats are rolling. MARCH 28, 2026 / 10:07 ET Knotted up Arizona went on a 7-0 run early in the second half to tie the game at 42-42. MARCH 28, 2026 / 10:07 ET Bear down Arizona is looking to find another gear in the second half. MARCH 28, 2026 / 9:50 ET Boilermakers brewing upset? Braden Smith has 11 points and Purdue is shooting 7-for-14 on 3s en route to a surprising 38-31 halftime lead over top seed Arizona. MARCH 28, 2026 / 9:32 ET Purdue pulls ahead Gicarri Harris gives the Boilermakers a 23-21 lead over Arizona. Harris cashes in from the corner 💰#MarchMadness @BoilerBall pic.twitter.com/qerpAXQnBF — NCAA March Madness (@MarchMadnessMBB) March 29, 2026 MARCH 28, 2026 / 9:16 ET Arizona and Purdue are underway MARCH 28, 2026 / 9:08 ET It lived up to expectations Illinois only hit three shots from 3-point land Saturday but took control down the stretch to end Iowa’s Cinderella run through the tournament. MARCH 28, 2026 / 8:42 ET Cutting down the nets "This group is special… Couldn't be more proud." 🥹 Brad Underwood is overcome with joy after @IlliniMBB's win to advance to the #MFinalFour 🗣️#MarchMadness pic.twitter.com/C2JLA2wq6M — NCAA March Madness (@MarchMadnessMBB) March 29, 2026 MARCH 28, 2026 / 8:39 ET Illini heading on the trip of a lifetime ARE YOU WITH US? For the first time since 2005, we're heading to the FINAL FOUR. pic.twitter.com/1lduiaqLhW — Illinois Men's Basketball (@IlliniMBB) March 29, 2026 MARCH 28, 2026 / 8:30 ET The first of the Final Four Keaton Wagler scores 25 points and Illinois advances to the Final Four with a 71-59 victory over a tough Iowa squad. (3) ILLINOIS IS INDY BOUND 🤩 The Illini defeat (9) Iowa 71-59 to book the first spot in the #MFinalFour 👏 #MarchMadness pic.twitter.com/hFGEh9lJnL — NCAA March Madness (@MarchMadnessMBB) March 29, 2026 MARCH 28, 2026 / 8:13 ET Breaking away Illinois takes control of the game with an 8-0 run. Buries it with time running out ⌛️#MarchMadness @IowaHoops pic.twitter.com/87moNsLttG — NCAA March Madness (@MarchMadnessMBB) March 28, 2026 MARCH 28, 2026 / 7:11 ET Iowa leads Illinois 32-28 at halftime. MARCH 28, 2026 / 5:30 ET Welcome to Day 1 of the Elite Eight! Coming to you live from the Toyota Center in Houston and the SAP Center in San Jose, it’s night one of the Elite Eight, as the 2026 Division I Men’s Basketball Tournament rolls on towards the Final Four. Here’s the complete schedule: No. 9 Iowa vs. No. 3 Illinois, 6:09 p.m. ET (TBS / TruTV) No. 2 Purdue vs. No. 1 Arizona, 8:49 ET (TBS / TruTV)
